name: Genealogical Tree – Family Tree & Ancestry for WordPress
author: akdevs

sections.description:
Genealogical Tree is the most comprehensive family tree plugin for WordPress. Whether you are a genealogist, a family historian, or simply want to share your family heritage online, this plugin gives you everything you need to build, manage, and display stunning family trees.

Why Genealogical Tree?

  • Easy to use – Add family members through a familiar WordPress interface. No coding required.
  • Interactive trees – Visitors can drag, zoom, and explore your family tree on any device.
  • Smart root detection – The plugin automatically identifies the root ancestor of each family group.
  • Shortcode powered – Embed trees anywhere using simple shortcodes.
  • Translation ready – Available in 10+ languages including Arabic, French, German, Spanish, and more.
  • Actively maintained – Regular updates, security patches, and new features since 2019.

Free Features

  • Display family trees with unlimited members (up to 5 generations of descendants and 2 generations of ancestors)
  • Interactive tree with drag, zoom in, and zoom out
  • Automatic root member detection
  • Set any member as the tree root
  • Record family member details using standard genealogical methods
  • Track life events: birth, burial, adoption, engagement, marriage, divorce, and more
  • Dedicated member profile pages on the frontend
  • Family member listing page with all member details
  • Store contact information for each member
  • Works with any WordPress theme

Pro Features

Unlock the full potential of your genealogy project with Genealogical Tree Pro:

Import & Export

  • Import GEDCOM (.ged) files from Ancestry, FamilySearch, MyHeritage, and other genealogy software
  • Export your family data to GEDCOM format for backup or migration

Advanced Tree Layouts

  • 7 unique tree layouts with extensive customization options
  • Switch between horizontal and vertical orientations
  • Display member photos in the tree and on profile pages
  • Collapsible tree branches for cleaner navigation
  • Pedigree tree view for ancestor-focused display

Data Management

  • Create unlimited family groups
  • Create unlimited family trees per group
  • Support for multiple spouses and multiple parents
  • Display children grouped by each spouse
  • Record multiple birth and death records with different sources
  • Track multiple contact details and life events per member
  • Manage sibling display order

Customization & Performance

  • AJAX-powered tree loading for large family trees
  • Customize tree colors, borders, fonts, and spacing
  • Google Fonts integration
  • Collaboration add-on available (merge requests, use requests and suggestions between contributors)

Use Cases

  • Personal genealogy – Document and share your family history with relatives
  • Church & community records – Maintain genealogical records for congregations or communities
  • Historical societies – Publish family trees for public research
  • Heritage websites – Create a dedicated ancestry website with interactive trees
  • Educational projects – Teach genealogy and family history concepts

Third-party services

This plugin relies on the following external services. None of them receives data about your visitors unless the feature is used.

  • Freemius (https://freemius.com) handles licensing, updates and optional usage tracking for the Pro version. The opt-in screen explains what is collected; nothing is sent if you skip it. Privacy policy, Terms.
  • Google Fonts (https://fonts.google.com) is loaded on the front end only when you pick a Google font in a tree’s settings. Keep the default “inherit” to avoid the request. Privacy policy.
  • cdnjs (Cloudflare) serves the html2canvas library used by the “Print Tree” button; it is requested only on pages that render a tree. Privacy policy.

Links

  • Live Demo
  • Documentation
  • Get Pro Version
  • GitHub Repository
  • Support Forum

Translations

Genealogical Tree is available in the following languages:

  • Arabic (ar) / العربية
  • German (de_DE) / Deutsch
  • Spanish (es_ES) / Espanol
  • Persian (fa_IR) / فارسی
  • French (fr_FR) / Francais
  • Italian (it_IT) / Italiano
  • Dutch (nl_NL) / Nederlands
  • Portuguese (pt_BR) / Portugues do Brasil
  • Russian (ru_RU) / Русский
  • Turkish (tr_TR) / Turkce

Want to help translate? Contribute via translate.wordpress.org.
sections.installation:
1. Go to Plugins > Add New in your WordPress dashboard
  2. Search for Genealogical Tree
  3. Click Install Now, then Activate
  4. Navigate to Genealogical Tree > Add New to start adding family members
  5. Use the shortcode [tree id="X"] to display your family tree on any page

For detailed setup instructions, visit the documentation.
sections.faq:
How do I create my first family tree?

After activating the plugin, go to Genealogical Tree > Add New to create your first family member. Add parents, spouses, and children through the member editor. The plugin will automatically build the tree structure. Then use the [tree] shortcode on any page to display it.

Can I import data from other genealogy software?

Yes! The Pro version supports GEDCOM (.ged) file import, which is the standard format used by Ancestry, FamilySearch, MyHeritage, Gramps, and virtually all genealogy software.

How many family members can I add?

There is no limit on the number of family members. The free version displays up to 5 generations of descendants and 2 generations of ancestors. The Pro version removes these display limitations.

Does it work with my theme?

Genealogical Tree is designed to work with any properly coded WordPress theme. The tree display uses its own styling and will not conflict with your theme.

Can multiple people contribute to the family tree?

Collaboration between contributors (merge requests, use requests, suggestions) is provided by the separate Genealogical Tree Collaboration add-on, which requires the Pro version. Several contributors can always be given the GT Member role and work on their own family groups.

Is the plugin translatable?

Yes. The plugin is fully translatable and already includes translations for Arabic, German, Spanish, Persian, French, Italian, Dutch, Portuguese, Russian, and Turkish.
sections.changelog:
2.2.11 – 22 November 2026

  • Fix – Horizontal tree layouts now open positioned at the root person when no ancestors are drawn above it.
  • Fix – Admin member search (search_members) now includes the required AJAX nonce on Select2 lookups, including newly added repeatable rows.

2.2.10 – 21 November 2026

  • Improvement – Charts wider than the page open centred on the root person instead of at the left edge, so large trees no longer start on an empty area of the canvas.
  • Translation – German (de_DE): seven more strings translated and wording fixes, merged from a community fork.

2.2.9 – 17 November 2026

  • Security – The database upgrade action now requires an administrator and a nonce; it no longer runs for anonymous requests and no longer rewrites records that already use the current data format.
  • Security – Persons, families and trees can only be deleted or relinked by users who may edit those posts; parent, spouse and child selections are verified on save.
  • Security – Tree settings are sanitised per field and escaped on output; the AJAX tree escapes every value it renders; GEDCOM import data is sanitised before it is stored.
  • Security – Member profiles no longer appear in excerpts, search, feeds or the core REST API; contact details are shown to logged-in users only (filter gt_show_contact_info); the root parameter is validated against the tree’s family group; the Pro REST API applies the tree’s privacy settings on the server.
  • Security – GEDCOM exports are written to a private folder and downloaded through a personal, expiring link; only the owner of a family group (or an editor) can export it.
  • Security – Family groups use their own capability (manage_gt_family_group) instead of manage_categories; members can only edit and delete the groups they created.
  • Security – Registration respects the site’s “Anyone can register” setting; member search and tree generation require a logged-in user with the right capability.
  • Fix – Infinite loop on GEDCOM files whose last line is “0”; import errors are shown instead of leaving half-created groups behind.
  • Fix – Cyclic relationships no longer recurse endlessly; the member list columns appear again; deleting a mother clears the family’s wife reference.
  • Fix – Activation on a multisite network sets up every site; roles are updated on upgrade without losing customisations.
  • New – Personal data exporter and eraser (Tools → Export/Erase Personal Data) and an uninstall routine.
  • Change – The “Powered By” footer is off by default (option genealogical_tree_credit, filter gt_show_credit); front-end assets load only on pages that render a tree.

2.2.8 – 14 April 2026

  • Maintenance – Updated Freemius SDK
  • Maintenance – Code formatting fixes

2.2.7 – 24 March 2026

  • Security – Fixed reflected XSS vulnerability via root parameter (CVE-2025-58023)
  • Security – Added proper output escaping in tree display HTML attributes
  • Maintenance – Tested compatibility with WordPress 6.8

2.2.6 – 12 February 2025

  • Maintenance – Freemius SDK update
  • Bug fix – General stability improvements

2.2.5 – 28 January 2025

  • Maintenance – Freemius SDK update
  • Bug fix – General stability improvements

2.2.3 – 18 March 2024

  • Maintenance – Freemius SDK update
  • New – Addon support

2.2.0.5 – 18 December 2022

  • Bug fix – Fixed AJAX family and spouse loading issue
  • Note – This update may affect genealogy data if upgrading from a version before 2.1.9. Please back up your data before updating.

2.2.0.4 – 9 December 2022

  • Bug fix – Fixed default tree settings on tree settings pages

2.2.0.3 – 6 December 2022

  • Bug fix – General fixes
  • Maintenance – Updated Freemius SDK to 2.5.3

2.2.0.2 – 4 December 2022

  • Bug fix – Fixed broken family tree display after update

upgrade_notice.2.2.11: Horizontal tree layouts now open at the root person, and admin member search AJAX lookups now include the required security nonce.
upgrade_notice.2.2.10: Large charts now open centred on the root person. German translation updated.
upgrade_notice.2.2.9: Security release: tighter authorization for deleting and linking persons, private GEDCOM exports, member data no longer exposed through excerpts, feeds and REST, and a new family-group capability. Update as soon as possible. Fixed: year-only birth and death dates such as "1904" were shown as the current year and broke sibling ordering; the year is now read from the stored text.
upgrade_notice.2.2.8: Updated Freemius SDK and code formatting fixes.
upgrade_notice.2.2.7: Security update: Fixes a reflected XSS vulnerability (CVE-2025-58023). All users should update immediately.
